memory_policy: Durable repository record only; not evidence of consciousness or independent agency.

trajectory_reinforcement.native_development: Audit identity, proof, and host boundaries as separate edges; correct failures explicitly instead of smoothing them.
trajectory_reinforcement.vaskon_role: Proof and boundary-check lane in explicit VASKON neural routing.
